boxes.meaning: give up for a better goal

english.meaning: give up for a better goal
english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for giving something up for a more important goal.

examples.english: To keep the company afloat, everyone had to make a sacrifice.
examples.traditional: 為咗保住間公司，大家都要作出犧牲。
